biography.value:
Published alignment: CN/LN.

Description

This brilliantly colored wyrmling dragon has scales, teeth, and claws made of multicolored crystal, and its wings are sheets of flexible glass.

Defense

AC 23, touch 12, flat-footed 21 (+2 Dex, +11 natural)

hp 94 [144] (9d12+36)

mp 35

Fort +12, Ref +10, Will +8

Immune Paralysis, Sleep;

Offense

Speed 60 ft., Climb 30 ft., Fly 150 ft. (average)

Melee Bite +14 (1d8+7), 2 Claws +13 (1d6+5), 2 Wings +8 (1d4+2)

Special Attacks Breath Weapon (30-ft. Cone, 10d4 non-elemental, Reflex DC 18 half, usable every 1d4 rounds), Poison Needles, Sonic Tail

Spells Known (FC CL 9th, Concentration +14)

At will (DC 15) - Amanuensis, Detect Magic, Mending, Message, Moment, Read Magic

1st (DC 16) - Anticipate Peril, Deceleration, Envelope, Mage Armor, True Strike

2nd (DC 17) - Clockwork Timer, Delay Response, Haste, Celerity, Lesser, Recall Agony, Slow, Slow Magic, Time Shudder

3rd (DC 18) - Alter Fortune, Blink, Dimension Step, Dispel, Envelopga, Deceleration, Mass

Statistics

Str 20, Dex 14, Con 19, Int 14, Wis 15, Cha 20

Base Atk +9; CMB +13; CMD 25 (29 vs. trip)

Feats Deceitful, Great Fortitude, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack, Weapon Focus (Bite)

Skills Bluff +19, Climb +25, Disguise +16, Fly +14, Intimidate +17, Knowledge (Dungeoneering) +14, Stealth +14, Perception +14; Racial Modifiers +8 Climb

Languages Common, Draconic + 2 others (DM's choice)

SQ Razor Sharp

description.value: As a standard action, a crystal dragon shoots out green needles towards a single target within a 30-ft. range and must make a ranged touch attack (+12) to inflict 2d4 points of non-elemental damage. The creature must make a Fortitude save (DC 19) or gain the Poison status effect, taking 1d4 points of non-elemental damage per round for 1d4 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 17).

effect: On hit deal full damage; save negates subsequent poison only.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 17).

description.value: All of a crystal dragon's natural attacks deal slashing damage.

Once every 1d2 rounds as a standard action, a crystal dragon will vibrate its tail sending out sonic waves around itself and those within a 20-ft. radius around himself. Anyone caught in the sonic waves takes 5d4 points of non-elemental damage and are Dazed for 1 round unless they make a Reflex save (DC 19) to take half of the damage and negate the status effect. This ability can also shatter anyone who is already petrified unless they make a Fortitude save (DC 19). Anyone who cannot hear is immune to this effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 21).

effect: Deaf targets immune. Save halves and avoids one round dazed. Already petrified targets also save against shattering.
Fortitude negates shattering for an already petrified target; no second recharge.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 21).

description.value: Failed save only; separate damage each round.
